headline: GSIS Earmarks Nearly ₱4.4 Billion in Emergency Loans for 166,789 Members and Pensioners
seoTitle: GSIS Opens Nearly ₱4.4B in Emergency Loans | FMB News
seoDescription: GSIS has earmarked nearly ₱4.4 billion in emergency loans for 166,789 eligible members and pensioners in nine Luzon areas affected by cyclones and the southwest monsoon.
deck: Eligible borrowers in nine Luzon calamity areas may apply through GSIS Touch, with loan amounts of up to ₱20,000 or ₱40,000 depending on existing emergency-loan balances.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Government Service Insurance System has earmarked nearly ₱4.4 billion in emergency loans for 166,789 active members and old-age and disability pensioners in nine Luzon areas affected by recent tropical cyclones and the southwest monsoon.
Qualified borrowers without an existing emergency loan may borrow up to ₱20,000. Those with an outstanding emergency-loan balance may avail of up to ₱40,000, subject to GSIS policies.

sections.heading: Loan terms and access
paragraphs: The emergency loan is payable in 36 equal monthly installments at 6% annual interest and is covered by loan redemption insurance. Applications may be submitted through the GSIS Touch mobile application, with approved proceeds credited to the borrower's GSIS eCard or UMID card.
Application deadlines vary by locality. GSIS said deadlines extend into September for several affected areas and into November for Cavite and Rodriguez, Rizal.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: GSIS emergency loans are limited to members and pensioners who meet the pension fund's eligibility rules and are linked to covered calamity areas. The facility is a repayable loan rather than a grant, and the applicable deadline depends on the borrower's locality.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Emergency credit can give public employees and pensioners short-term liquidity after floods and other disasters, but borrowers should still account for the three-year repayment obligation when deciding whether to take the loan.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Eligibility depends on the member's or pensioner's location and GSIS rules. Residents and workers in newly declared calamity areas should check official GSIS advisories for any expansion of the loan window.
